title: Easy Imagemap (REDCap External Module)
description: Easy Imagemap is a REDCap External Module for turning inline images in descriptive fields into clickable, responsive image maps. It provides a visual designer for polygon, rectangle, circle, and ellipse areas, links those areas to checkbox, radio, select, yes/no, or true/false fields, and stores the map configuration in the @EASYIMAGEMAP action tag as REDCap project metadata.
